Where I Stand

A Poetic Prelude

A quiet reflection on uncertainty, reinvention and what it means to begin again while standing between identities, countries and chapters.

23 July 20252 min read
ReinventionIdentityReflection

A quiet reflection on uncertainty, reinvention, and what it means to begin again.

A husband. A father. Packed up a life, chased a new one across oceans and time zones, with nothing but belief folded between documents and dreams. And paperwork that doesn’t always move with your plans.

I’m in the middle of an MBA. They call it executive. But sometimes, it feels like it’s executing me. Let’s just say the winds aren’t exactly gentle right now.

There’s too much riding on this chapter, And I wonder: Am I chasing success, or just outrunning fear?

And then, on a bench, in the calm between two storms, a friend sits beside me. Looks me in the eye. Doesn’t ask. Doesn’t fix. Just says:

“Let me tell you a story. It’s mine. But maybe, just maybe, you’ll see yourself in it.”

And so it begins. A memory. A mirror. One story at a time.

About this series: This is the first entry of a storytelling series. It isn’t advice. It isn’t a playbook. It’s just a life, told in pieces, sometimes messy, sometimes meaningful.

If any part of it resonates with you, I invite you to follow along.
